main_metric: dev41 sequence-equal nonPAD positional accuracy; first average all8 S draws within each original sequence, then equal41 sequence mean
main_threshold: M minus S8 >=1/20 by exact rational correct-count/target-length arithmetic
main_gate_requirements: Every fixed320x9 model output finite and complete; failed/not_executed/nonfinite/missing rows make gate NOT_EVALUABLE. Complete empty/J48 outputs remain in denominator. Property failures do not affect the accuracy gate.
feature_policy: Reuse frozen421 vector: length/48,20AA fractions,400dipeptide fractions, each block1/sqrt(3). Report full signed prediction-reference vector plus per-block signed_sum/L1/squared_L2 for R→M,R→S,M→S; no refit or new kernel.
descriptor_policy: Call original representation(sequence,terminal)[global_raw], 9 raw RDKit descriptors. Cache exact (sequence,terminal), deterministic R then M then S0..7, train then dev,row_id ascending. Empty/invalid/error/nonfinite/timeout is missing, not zero. No new activity model or chemical interpretation.
descriptor_units: Original raw function/version; source has no explicit units table, no substitute/normalized quantities.
timeout_policy: Stop computation at300s, retain partial stages and missingness. Check again after all manifest/result writes; CLOSING_LEDGER is authoritative terminal state. No retry or descriptor substitution. Outer360s watchdog covers final bookkeeping and interpreter exit.
postflight_requirements: PASS exact model scope plus model contract and output manifest path/sha bindings; scorer resolves CSV hashes from bound output manifest.
interpretation: Investment screen only, no significance/causal proof/independent training or biological replicates; crossing does not authorize training.
supported_AA_macro: For each split and terminal scope, equal mean of supported-AA recalls. M/S individual use correct/support; S8 uses correct pooled across8/(8*original AA support); incomplete prediction makes macro missing, no survivor seed aggregation.
nonpad_error: Explicit1 minus per-sequence nonPAD accuracy; S8 averages all8 within sequence then equals sequence weights.

reuse.only_code_change: SCOPE constant changed from AMP_H5_CE_RMS_SCORING_V2 to AMP_H5_WARMUP_RMS_SCORING_V1; all scoring mathematics, source calls and CLI are byte-identical
reuse.old_internal_investment_screen: M-minus-S screen is retained descriptively by the unchanged scorer; warmup resource success is exclusively the separate paired four-guard reader.

late_binding: New weights and training receipt must be separately bound and independently approved by the model RMS contract before its execution; scorer only accepts exact postflight PASS with bound model contract/output manifest. This preparation does not authorize training, forwards or scoring.
